$comment: Pre-registration for McBylaw Phase 2 validation round 0 = P2-0, the K7-R re-run (phase2-plan-v2 §K.2, §K.3, §K.4, §V-4, §V-6). Committed BEFORE the round; validate-round.mjs records prereg_status from HEAD's blob of this path. Edits after a round has run need a new round id. Schema: prereg.schema.json. Locked by src/tests/bylaw-validate-round.infra.test.ts.

k7r.codes_source: scripts/analysis/bylaw/evaluate.mjs NOT_EVALUATED_CODES (24 codes at 2d7b0d84, M-60 hardened)
k7r.lot_gates_source: phase2-plan-v2 §A.1 L13 lot_gate set (Layer 2 only, never passed to the evaluator); moves to scripts/seeds/bylaw/layer2-map.json at P2-4, which then becomes the lock's source

classes.i: planned-unkeyed: work a named plan step will key (K.2 a)
classes.ii: structural: missing data dependency, input, grammar form or map (K.2 a: everything else unavailable)
classes.i_if_planned: class i only where planned_keying names the (zone, target) pair, else class ii (K.2 a)
classes.not_unavailable: not an unavailable item (a value, a conflict, or lot gate none)

notes.needs_user_input: class (ii) until the scenario-class catalogue (scripts/seeds/bylaw/scenario-classes.json, Q12) is ratified (operator 2026-10-14, Q2 a); then re-mapped by a new prereg
notes.not_modelled:target_not_keyed: class (i) only when the item's exception is a member of the generated W1 shard plan (planned_keying_source, step P2-5); otherwise class (ii)

planned_keying_source.rule: planned exceptions = members[].regulation_id of the GENERATED W1 shard plan (keying-cli.mjs plan --batch W1), read by path; blob_sha pins it (git blob id of the LF file). blob_sha null (placeholder until the re-planned file lands), the file absent, or a different sha => k7r_split not_run:stale_pin (fail closed). Never a hand-written list (operator 2026-10-14, Q1 a)

keyed_scope.definition: items of wave 0 (the Phase 1 keyed table) + the 30 E-5 exceptions; an item outside counts toward the original K7 only

kill.post_hoc_basis: the 5 % line was chosen after the trial's (ii) baseline of 352 / 102,960 = 0.34 % (phase2-plan-v2 §K.2 d, MATRIX §5); the report prints the original K7 beside K7-R

probe.rule: ranks rank_from..rank_to ordered by sha256('<seed>:<rank>') hex ascending, the first n taken, then sorted numerically (validate-round.mjs probeRanks); rank = wave-1 rank by INCLUDE-closed residential lots (Spec 69 M-15, k7.mjs ordering); each sampled exception is read only far enough to classify every clause as expressible or not in the current grammar
probe.kill: any clause class with no grammar form => a named grammar extension in P2-4 before wave 1, not a kill of the plan (K.2 c)

k3.measures: b2 cells and bytes/row at TS = targets x {principal, suite, ancillary} with scenario classes inside the row, against K5

limits.source: .cursor/mcbylaw/phase2-panel/data-measured.md:157 K5 "projected steady Layer 2 (rows + indexes) >10 % of DB ... at the operator-set TS -> reject that shape" (TRIAL-REPORT.md:10: thresholds as fixed in §5)

k3.measures: ms/lot and ms/cell with the hardened evaluator (M-60(f) enumeration)

limits.source: .cursor/mcbylaw/phase2-panel/data-measured.md:158 K5 "100 K-lot ms/lot >2x the 20 K figure -> reject the linear model"

k3.missing_sources: ms/cell has no budget in any source (K5 sets none); recorded, not judged — not invented

k3.measures: I12 static-closure misses (lots) with the hardened inputs[] union the static key; the trial's 602 must be 0
WAL bytes of a no-change run with the anti-join prefilter and table_version out of the guard
the K7-R splits, item- and lot-weighted (judged by the k7r_split element)
every count the plan's invariants cite (I1, I5, I6, I7 bases), regenerated by the script cited beside it

B.what: independent per-lot resolver scripts/analysis/bylaw/oracle-b/ vs the production evaluator (compare.mjs); labelled resolver agreement, never accuracy (R-ORACLE)
B.pass_rule: 0 unadjudicated A/B disagreements (V-5: majority never decides)

C.what: CoA decision notices, required-by-by-law side (lane I, scripts/analysis/bylaw/oracle-c.mjs)

contract.input: --oracle-c <path to an oracle C round record>
contract.table_binding: inputs.provisions.sha256 must equal this round's pins.table_sha256, else not_run:table_mismatch
contract.verdict: Phase 2 is report-only (P2-12, Q8): counts recorded, verdict not_run:no_preregistered_threshold until a prereg sets the SC-5 target

D.what: expert examiner's stratified sample (G-AUDIT, Phase 1 S14, unbuilt)
D.basis: operator 2026-10-14: no expert audit soon. D stays not_run on every round and is disclosed; the accuracy bar is now oracle C plus an operator law-text sample (C-9 (c)). An element not run is never a PASS

E.what: shadow diff vs current production values (field-map.json columns), closed classifier §V-2 E

draw.order: sha256(salt:parcel_id) ascending, n_per_stratum lowest per stratum, exhaustive when the stratum is smaller

heldout.rule: the operator runs `validate-round.mjs commit-heldout --round=0` (salt ONLY from env MCBYLAW_HELDOUT_SALT, never written): per residential zone stratum (vocab.json zone), the n_per_stratum parcels with the lowest sha256(salt:parcel_id), exhaustive when the stratum is smaller; writes commitment_sha256 = sha256(sorted ids joined by LF + LF + salt) and the draw parameters here; verified at reveal (--heldout-reveal, same env salt, re-drawn from the DB); revealed sets join regression-pool.json; round 0 reuses the trial's published K-sample ids for K-measurements (not held-out). The other V-4 strata (waves, overlays, structures, classes) need Layer 2 and are drawn in later rounds

double_check.rule: phase2-plan-v2 §K.4: a second Claude seat re-runs validate-round against the same pins and DB counts; any difference > 0 on a deterministic number fails the round (--second-seat <record>)

reads: parcels: count(*) where zoning_class in vocab.json zone (residential, by zone)
